integrity: The complete proof of general scheme-length two and generic uniqueness is supplied. Finite exact-arithmetic checker cases provide corroboration, not a substitute for the proof. No external independent scientific verification is claimed.
limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-two fields; generic tangent hyperplanes to odd binary Segre products with at least three factors. No exceptional-contact or even-factor classification. The broad nonreflexivity criterion is previously known. Equivalent exact degree-two statements in older conormal literature remain a possibility.
title: Generic double contact for odd binary Segre duals in characteristic two
